craft_notes: Sthāyin: warrant. Sanskrit-first: Brahmayāmala named aloud. Rows: 3. Close: inner flood. Rejected: dropping the citation — killed: warrant is content. Read aloud: charter cadence — book, whole, cut.

lines: Small rite, whole pervading — the old book grants;
no outer flourish, all inner flood.
